schools.note: Group lessons from age 6 for confident swimmers (50m), one-to-one lessons from age 4, private family lessons, SUP lessons, surf clubs and special needs surfing.

schools.name: Bantham Surfing Academy
schools.base: Mobile; teaches around Sedgewell Cove and Bigbury Bay, reaching Bantham via Sedgewell
schools.note: Beginner, kids', improver, private and bodyboarding lessons, plus SUP lessons and tours and a kids' surf club. Picks the best spot each day.

hire.name: Discovery Surf School

lessonsIntro: Bigbury-on-Sea has a surf school in the beach car park, and the wide, gently shelving beach is a friendly place for families to learn.

text: Bigbury is a family beach with a gently sloping shoreline, and local guides rate it highly for beginners. Discovery Surf School runs lessons from the lower car park next to Venus Cafe, and says Bigbury can run in most surf and weather conditions. Lesson times move with the tide so you're in the water when the waves are likely to be best. If it's flat, you can usually switch to a paddleboard lesson.

The beach faces Burgh Island, and at low tide a sand causeway links the two. As the tide comes in the sea covers the causeway, so keep an eye on the water if you're walking out. RNLI lifeguards cover Bigbury in the peak summer weeks only, from 11 July to 6 September in 2026. Outside those dates there's no patrol, so learning with a school is the safest option.

cards.label: Level
cards.title: Beginners and families
cards.text: Gently sloping sand and a surf school on site make it a good first beach.

cards.label: Best time
cards.title: Summer holidays
cards.text: RNLI lifeguards patrol 11 July to 6 September 2026, 10am to 6pm.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: The tide on the causeway
cards.text: The incoming tide covers the causeway to Burgh Island. No flags means no lifeguards.

hireIntro: You can hire surf kit from the beach car park, and in the summer holidays there's a hire station on the beach by the causeway.

text: A big soft board is the right choice while you learn; improvers can move to a mid-length when the waves are cleaner. Bigbury's calm days suit paddleboards and kayaks, both available to hire. The sea here runs from about 15-19C in mid-August to 9-10C in early March. A 3/2mm or 4/3mm suits summer; in colder months Discovery Surf School puts everyone in a 5mm suit, with boots, gloves and a hood available.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Soft board to begin
cards.text: Start on a soft board; step down in size as you start catching unbroken waves.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 3/2 summer, 5mm winter
cards.text: A 3/2mm or 4/3mm in summer; a 5mm suit with boots, gloves and a hood in the colder months.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: SUP and kayaks
cards.text: Paddleboards and kayaks are hired from the causeway side in summer. An XL SUP needs at least three good paddlers.

shopsIntro: There's a small surf school shop in the beach car park, and a full surf shop a short drive away near Kingsbridge.
shopsText: Discovery Surf School's shop in the lower beach car park sells its own hoodies and changing robes, and you can hire boards and wetsuits there. For buying a board or wetsuit, Triocean Surf at Churchstow near Kingsbridge stocks wetsuits, surfboards, bodyboards and paddleboards, and repairs boards and wetsuits.

lessons.q: Where is the surf school at Bigbury?
lessons.a: Discovery Surf School is on the lower level of the beach car park, next to Venus Cafe (TQ7 4AS).

lessons.q: What if there are no waves?
lessons.a: Discovery offers to reschedule, refund or, for suitable groups, switch you to a paddleboard lesson.

lessons.q: Do I need to be able to swim?
lessons.a: Yes. Group lessons need you to swim 50m confidently. Less confident swimmers can book a one-to-one lesson.

hire.q: Can I hire on the beach itself?
hire.a: In the main summer holidays, when the weather is good, Discovery runs a hire station on the causeway side for SUPs, kayaks and bodyboards.

hire.q: Is there an accessible beach wheelchair?
hire.a: Discovery Surf School has a free beach wheelchair available.

shops.q: Can I buy a wetsuit at Bigbury?
shops.a: The beach shop sells hoodies and robes. For wetsuits, Triocean Surf near Kingsbridge is the nearest specialist.
